name: dsh-superagent
author: DeepSeek Harness Team <team@dsh.dev>
description: A proactive agent for one GitHub repository, as a DSH (DeepSeek Harness) bundle: it listens to GitHub and optionally Feishu, evaluates requests under a Policy, turns authorized ones into Tickets, and executes each in its own DSH Session.
